parameters.content:
## Reminders – Upsert

**POST** `/webhook/reminders/upsert`

Creates or updates a note or reminder. PostgreSQL receives every dynamic value through prepared-statement parameters; no request value is interpolated into SQL.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "id": "optional-uuid",
  "type": "note | reminder",
  "calendar_id": "42 | null",
  "title": "Llamar a laboratorio",
  "description": "Detalles opcionales",
  "start_datetime": "2026-05-13T13:45:00",
  "end_datetime": "2026-05-13T14:00:00",
  "color": "#5484ed",
  "priority": "MEDIUM",
  "status": "pending",
  "visibility": "clinic | personal",
  "raise_alert": true
}
```

**Alcance (`visibility`)**
- `clinic` (compartido, el default): lo edita cualquier usuario del staff.
- `personal`: solo lo edita su autor (`created_by`). Un ítem sin autor — filas viejas o
  cuyo autor fue dado de baja, la FK es `ON DELETE SET NULL` — se trata como compartido.

La autorización vive en el `ON CONFLICT ... WHERE`, y `visibility` solo la cambia el
autor. Misma regla que `canManageReminder` en el frontend y que el filtro del GET.

`calendar_id` is nullable. `created_by` and completion ownership come from the authenticated JWT, never from the request body. Notes always persist with `raise_alert = false`. Alert scheduling remains the responsibility of the alert workflows; this endpoint does not create `alert_instances`.

**Response 200:** `{ "success": true, "code": 200, "reminder": { ... } }`
**Response 403:** el ítem guardado es personal de otro usuario.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.reminders AS existing (
  id,
  type,
  calendar_id,
  title,
  description,
  start_datetime,
  end_datetime,
  color,
  priority,
  status,
  visibility,
  raise_alert,
  created_by,
  completed_at,
  completed_by,
  created_at,
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  COALESCE($1::uuid, gen_random_uuid()),
  $2::character varying,
  $3::bigint,
  $4::text,
  $5::text,
  $6::timestamp,
  $7::timestamp,
  $8::character varying,
  $9::character varying,
  $10::character varying,
  $13::character varying,
  CASE WHEN $2::text = 'note' THEN FALSE ELSE $11::boolean END,
  $12::uuid,
  CASE WHEN $10::text = 'done' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
  CASE WHEN $10::text = 'done' THEN $12::uuid ELSE NULL END,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
SET type           = EXCLUDED.type,
    calendar_id    = EXCLUDED.calendar_id,
    title          = EXCLUDED.title,
    description    = EXCLUDED.description,
    start_datetime = EXCLUDED.start_datetime,
    end_datetime   = EXCLUDED.end_datetime,
    color          = EXCLUDED.color,
    priority       = EXCLUDED.priority,
    status         = EXCLUDED.status,
    visibility     = CASE
                       -- El alcance solo lo cambia el autor. Si B marcara "solo para mí"
                       -- un ítem de A, created_by seguiría siendo A: el ítem pasaría a ser
                       -- personal DE A y desaparecería del calendario de B, sin forma de
                       -- revertirlo desde la UI. Misma razón que isScopeLocked en el form.
                       WHEN existing.created_by IS NULL OR existing.created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by
                         THEN EXCLUDED.visibility
                       ELSE existing.visibility
                     END,
    raise_alert    = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.type = 'note' THEN FALSE ELSE EXCLUDED.raise_alert END,
    completed_at   = CASE
                       WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'done' THEN COALESCE(existing.completed_at, NOW())
                       ELSE NULL
                     END,
    completed_by   = CASE
                       WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'done' THEN COALESCE(existing.completed_by, EXCLUDED.completed_by)
                       ELSE NULL
                     END,
    updated_at     = NOW()
-- Lo compartido lo edita cualquiera; lo personal, solo su autor. EXCLUDED.created_by es
-- el actor del JWT, así que esto compara "lo guardado" contra "quien edita".
--
-- El IS NULL no es defensivo de más: `NULL = 'uuid'` da NULL, no false, así que sin él
-- las filas sin autor (viejas, o con el autor dado de baja — la FK es ON DELETE SET NULL)
-- no las podría editar nadie, nunca.
WHERE existing.visibility <> 'personal'
   OR existing.created_by IS NULL
   OR existing.created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by
RETURNING
  id::text AS id,
  type,
  calendar_id::text AS calendar_id,
  title,
  description,
  start_datetime::text AS start_datetime,
  end_datetime::text AS end_datetime,
  color,
  priority,
  status,
  visibility,
  raise_alert,
  alert_instance_id,
  created_by::text AS created_by,
  created_at::text AS created_at,
  updated_at::text AS updated_at,
  completed_at::text AS completed_at,
  completed_by::text AS completed_by;
